reviewed_by: MyWay automated BlendKit CC0 intake policy

basis.label: Asset-specific BlendKit API record
basis.finding: The captured source metadata reports the asset license as CC0. MyWay rejects the intake if the returned license is not exactly CC0.

basis.label: BlendKit license documentation
basis.finding: BlendKit describes CC0 as permitting unrestricted use, including commercial use and redistribution.

basis.label: BlendKit licensing FAQ
basis.finding: BlendKit states that CC0 technically permits any use of the asset.

notes: Automated approval is limited to an exact CC0 license value captured from BlendKit for a generic fruit subject. The user still reviews visual quality before uploading the runtime GLB to Cloudflare R2.
